performance.verdict: Lead surge is real but isolated; 9 overdue SOW milestones now block any scale.

findings.text: CPL collapsed 86.32% week-over-week to ~$74.95 blended, driven entirely by Meta's 21 leads — Google Ads logged 0 attributable leads in the 28-day window despite $971.05 spend.
9 SOW milestones are overdue (oldest: 2026-07-31 booking bot battle-test); heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, and fall creative are all past due as of today 2026-10-17.
3-day lead signal (Oct 14–16: 0, 1, 5 leads) vs prior 3 days (Oct 11–13: 0, 0, 0) shows a late-week spike, but GBP actions have been 0 for 7 straight days — organic dark since Oct 10.

GHL shows 767 opportunities created vs 140 contacts and 61 won — a 92% opportunity-to-contact ratio mismatch suggests duplicate or auto-created opp records, not genuine lead intake. Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7.
Google spend is highly erratic: $198.89 on Oct 2, then $0 on Oct 3–4, normalizing to ~$16–57/day — BWS-Heating-Search-Calls absorbed $463.62 of $971.05 (48%) with no confirmed lead attribution.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL seat coverage immediately; speed-to-lead automation is pointing at an empty role since 7/7.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the intake owner seat is still unconfirmed per the SOW Aug-31 milestone. GHL shows 767 opportunities against only 140 contacts, signalling possible auto-create noise masking real missed leads. Confirm the named intake owner, their GHL login, and after-hours coverage. Success: named owner confirmed in writing and GHL pipeline audit complete by 2026-10-24.

suggestions.text: Escalate the 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer/Sohib; heating campaigns and LSA re-enable are past due — heating season is live now.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones are overdue, including heating campaigns (Google & Meta) due 2026-10-01, LSA re-enable due 2026-09-01, and fall creative due 2026-09-30. BWS-Heating-Search-Calls has already absorbed $463.62 in 28 days with zero confirmed lead conversions — heating season is active and these gaps are costing opportunity. Raise all 9 items with Nacer and Sohib this week and set hard delivery dates. Success: all 9 milestones have an owner and a new due date by 2026-10-21.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL for 3 more days before scaling; 5-lead spike on Oct 16 is a single-day event, not yet a confirmed 3-day signal.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered all 21 tracked leads at a $74.95 blended CPL, but the volume is concentrated — 5 leads appeared on Oct 16 after 13 consecutive zero-lead days. The 3-day signal (Oct 14–16) is only 6 leads total. Hold the current ~$21/day Meta budget and re-check on 2026-10-20. Success check: if CPL holds below $100 and leads ≥ 2/day across the next 3 days, bring a scale suggestion to the next cycle.
